name: slopgrade-firewall
description: Deterministic security-leak detection for CI — the open-source client of the slopGrade Firewall. Free tier: the 10 highest-severity classes (SQLi, command injection, XSS, SSRF, XXE, insecure deserialization, path traversal, hardcoded secrets, broken crypto, CORS); paid repos run the full detector catalogue in the same runner. $0, no source-code egress (only a structural fingerprint is posted for classification), zero secrets (GitHub OIDC).
author: Maxor Global LLC
